remarks: A spectacular residence, built in 2024, is now ready to welcome new tenants. This contemporary townhome, boasting four bedrooms and three and a half bathrooms, is a marvel of bespoke craftsmanship and scrupulous attention to detail. As you cross the threshold, prepare to be mesmerized by the expansive open-plan design, perfectly suited for a fast-paced modern lifestyle. Sunbeams stream in through spacious windows, accentuated by energy-saving LED lights. An attached garage provides easy access to the townhome mud room with a heated floor. The gourmet kitchen is a sanctuary for any Epicurean enthusiast. Modern appliances, substantial storage areas, and quartz countertops are set to ignite your culinary creativity. The conjoined living and dining room, warmed by a cozy fireplace, a perfect setting for memorable gatherings or tranquil, casual nights in. The upper level hosts a capacious bedroom suite with ample closet space, and a grand primary bedroom replete with a contemporary spa-like bathroom. An additional two bedrooms reside on the top floor, sharing a Jack and Jill bathroom. Located in the pulsating heart of Stamford, this residence provides effortless access to an array of excellent dining establishments, cafes, and serene beaches. The Amtrak/Metro Train Station is only steps away, providing quick access to NYC in just 55 minutes. Envision making this extraordinary space your home, and heralding a refreshing chapter in your life story.
